hut:Tamped earth floor.note_zh: 把泥土地整平、踩實，是蓋房子的第一步。
hut:Tamped earth floor.note_en: Earth levelled and tamped: the first step of building.

hut:Wall post (hewn, flat).note_zh: 扁平的木柱，埋進土裡約 50 公分。
hut:Wall post (hewn, flat).note_en: Flat hewn post, set about 50 cm into the ground.

hut:Pillar (dark lumber).note_zh: 四個角落和兩邊長邊的中間各一根，共六根。
hut:Pillar (dark lumber).note_en: One at each corner and one in the middle of each long side: six in all.

hut:Ridge post (satoko), forked.note_zh: 立在山牆裡，分叉的頂端托住屋脊樑。
hut:Ridge post (satoko), forked.note_en: Stands inside the gable; its forked top cradles the ridge pole.

hut:King post, forked.note_zh: 站在橫樑上，分叉的頂端托住屋脊樑。
hut:King post, forked.note_en: Stands on a tie beam; its forked top cradles the ridge pole.

hut:Tie beam.note_zh: 橫跨每一對柱子，用藤綁在柱頂。
hut:Tie beam.note_en: Spans each pair of posts, tied to the post heads with rattan.

hut:Wall plate (falag).note_zh: 放在橫樑上，沿著長邊，椽子綁在上面。
hut:Wall plate (falag).note_en: Lies on the tie beams along the long sides; the rafters are tied to it.

hut:Ridge pole.note_en: The highest timber of the roof.

hut:Rattan lashing.note_zh: 每個接點都用黃藤綁，不用鐵釘。
hut:Rattan lashing.note_en: Every joint is tied with rattan, no nails.

hut:Rafter (thorny bamboo).note_zh: 大約 50 公分一根，在屋脊上交叉。
hut:Rafter (thorny bamboo).note_en: About 50 cm apart, crossing over the ridge.

hut:Roof lining lath (raina, split arrow.note_zh: 箭竹剖半，三片綁成一條，橫放在椽子上。
hut:Roof lining lath (raina, split arrow.note_en: Arrow bamboo split in half, three halves tied into one lath, laid across the rafters.

hut:Cogon thatch (白茅).note_zh: 白茅一束一束，從屋簷一層一層往上鋪。
hut:Cogon thatch (白茅).note_en: Cogon grass in bundles, laid course by course from the eaves up.

hut:Pressing poles (silvergrass, 五節芒).note_zh: 五節芒的莖三支一束，壓在茅草上，用藤縫住。
hut:Pressing poles (silvergrass, 五節芒).note_en: Bundles of three silvergrass stems pressed across the thatch, stitched down with rattan.

hut:Hearth stone.note_zh: 三顆石頭圍成火塘，沒有煙囪。
hut:Hearth stone.note_en: Three stones make the hearth; there is no chimney.

raft:culm.note_zh: 外側的竹子最粗，每根都有自然的彎曲。
raft:culm.note_en: The outer culms are the largest; every culm has its natural crooks.

raft:keel.note_zh: 船尾兩側底下各三根，疊成三角形。
raft:keel.note_en: Three culms under each side toward the stern, stacked in a triangle.

raft:crossbeam.note_zh: 橫放在竹子上，每個交叉點都用藤綁。
raft:crossbeam.note_en: Laid across the culms; every crossing is tied with rattan.

raft:brace.note_zh: 插在槳架的洞裡，用兩個藤結綁在竹子上。
raft:brace.note_en: Set in a hole in the oar post and tied to the culms with two rattan knots.

raft:rail.note_zh: 每邊一根細竹，放在橫木的末端。
raft:rail.note_en: One thin culm per side, on the ends of the crossbeams.

raft:deck-mat.note_zh: 剖開的竹片編成的墊子，放在橫木之間。
raft:deck-mat.note_en: Mats woven from split bamboo, laid between the crossbeams.

raft:oarpost.note_zh: 削過的木頭，穿在舷竹上，靠著橫木。
raft:oarpost.note_en: A hewn post threaded on the rail, against a crossbeam.

raft:lashing.note_zh: 每個交叉點都用黃藤綁緊。
raft:lashing.note_en: Every crossing is tied tight with rattan.

sup:tail-loop.note_zh: 可以提板子，也可以扣腳繩。
sup:tail-loop.note_en: For carrying the board or clipping a leash.

sup:deck-slats.note_zh: 剖開的竹片橫放，綁在最外側的竹子上。
sup:deck-slats.note_en: Split bamboo slats laid across, tied to the outer culms.
